newsitem.title: MADAGASCAR: Madagascar bans "The Last Temptation of Christ".
newsitem.headline: Madagascar bans "The Last Temptation of Christ".

text.p: The government of Madagascar has banned a private television station from broadcasting Martin Scorcese's controversial film "The Last Temptation of Christ".
Radio Television Analamanga had wanted to show the film this weekend but the Interior Ministry banned it under a censorship law passed in 1990.
"It has nothing to do with political censorship. It is a decision taken in the name of moral and Christian ethics," said a ministry statement.
Another private television station, MA-TV, had planned to broadcast the film earlier this year but it backed off under pressure from Madagascar's religious leaders.

Antananarivo newspapers said on Saturday that the ministry's decision to ban the film was surprising, given that copies are available in video rental shops, along with pornographic films which also violate the 1990 law.
"The Last Temptation of Christ" was widely attacked by Christian groups when it first appeared because of its fictional portrayal of Christ as a man with human failings.
